basics.name: Qingrui Pan (潘卿锐)
basics.label: Short Range Wireless Engineer
basics.summary: Short Range Wireless Engineer at Huawei Research Institute Singapore, working on RFID, SparkLink Passive, and IEEE 802.11bp (AMP) technologies. Previously a postdoctoral researcher at the University of Edinburgh. Ph.D. from The Hong Kong Polytechnic University.

work.name: Huawei Research Institute Singapore
work.summary: Pre-research, technology scouting, and patent development across RFID, SparkLink Passive, and IEEE 802.11bp (AMP) short-range wireless technologies.
highlights: Filed 5 CN invention patents as primary inventor (2 additional in preparation); contributed to 7 patents in total.
Participated in IEEE 802.11 standardization as a registered voter — attended 4 Interim/Plenary sessions and submitted 6 technical contributions for the AMP amendment.
Designed and developed an AMP MAC-layer simulation system supporting three random access modes, full time-slot collision visualization, and batch experiment CDF comparison.
Supported and validated over 5 colleague patents via simulation-based testing.
Contributed to 2 IMU/PDR technology projects — implemented EKF-based signal optimization and user-turn detection, achieving ~100% accuracy under controlled lab conditions.

work.name: University of Edinburgh
work.summary: Supervisor: Prof. Mahesh K. Marina. Research on NextG Open RAN as a sensing infrastructure, spectrum regulation for private mobile networks, and IQ data compression for wireless systems.

work.name: Huawei Technologies, Co. Ltd
work.summary: Developed a preliminary indoor RFID localization system using a 4×4 antenna array to locate passive UHF RFID tags. Achieved localization error < 10 cm.

work.name: Moxie Culture Communication, Co.
work.summary: Main writer for 20+ non-fiction science comics totalling 300 million views; co-published four books with 600,000+ copies sold.

work.name: Technische Hochschule Nürnberg
work.summary: Bird species recognition via STFT feature extraction; built a MATLAB GUI for manual key segment cutting.
